CMSVideos.Caption: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North - Release Trailer

PreviewImage.Caption: Age of Empires IV: Raiders of the North - Release Trailer

Images.Caption: An overhead view of a fortified Viking coastal settlement beside a wide harbor. Wooden palisade walls and watchtowers surround homes and workshops, while several Viking longships with blue-and-white sails move through the water near docks and waterfront buildings.

An overhead view of fighting across the countryside surrounding a Scottish village. Groups of soldiers clash along roads and fields covered in purple flowers, while villagers and livestock remain scattered among farms, small buildings, defensive towers, and wooded hills.

A large battle around a snow-covered fortified settlement. Green Viking forces advance across a river toward red defenders, with cavalry and infantry fighting near the shoreline as several ships burn and siege weapons exchange fire beside castle walls and towers.

An overhead view of a busy Scottish town beside a river. Blue troops gather among stone churches, fortified buildings, homes, and fields while opposing soldiers cross a stone bridge into the settlement, creating a large battle through the town streets.

An overhead view of a large battle in a tropical settlement, with blue and red forces fighting around a central monument. Mounted units, infantry, and archers clash across roads and open ground as smoke and flashes of blue lightning strike the grounod at the center of the battlefield.

A desert battlefield surrounding a fortified stone stronghold. Blue and orange forces fight among tents, siege equipment in the distance, mounted units, and scattered buildings, with smoke and fire rising near the fortress and along the edge of the settlement.

A fortified Viking harbor settlement surrounded by mist. Wooden walls and watchtowers protect homes, farms, workshops, and a large central hall, while numerous Viking longships with colorful sails gather in the harbor beside docks and waterfront buildings.

A large medieval town during a battle. Red-clad troops advance through crowded streets and across a stone bridge toward blue defenders, with smoke rising among homes, markets, churches, and other buildings beside a river.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
A new force rises in this latest expansion to Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition! 

What’s New in Raiders of the North 

•	Two New Civilizations – Vikings and Scots, each with distinct systems and evolving playstyles, as well as new architecture, masteries, music and evolving language. 
•	Expanded Crucible Mode – Four new missions and deeper progression with Boons, Perks, Mutators, and Civilization-specific Talent Tracks  
•	Solo and two-player Co-op Crucible– Take on new and reimagined challenges alone or with a friend. 
•	Two New Biomes – Scottish Heathland and Tundra Summer shape the look and feel of the battlefield 
 
The Vikings 

The Vikings arrive as a relentless power shaped by raids, mobile and adaptable infantry, and the promise of glory that will echo through the ages.  Fast melee infantry, early naval dominance, and a resilient economy built around the Longhouse define their early strength. As time progresses, their society transforms. Pagan traditions give way to emerging kingdoms, and their armies adapt with knights and trained militias while their legacy is carried forward through heroic Sagas that grant lasting power. 

The Scots 

The Scots stand firm as a resilient and defensive civilization. Their strength lies in disciplined infantry, fortified defenses, and a unique food economy driven by Highland cattle and fishponds. From tower houses to grand castles, their presence on the battlefield reflects a nation forged through conflict. The Mustering Hall allows players to shape their forces between Highland and Lowland strengths, creating tactical flexibility in every match. 

The Crucible Expands 

Raiders of the North introduces four new Crucible missions with fresh challenges like seaborne raiders and civil war among Scottish clans.  Now playable solo or in two-player co-op, the mode expands with new Objectives, Boons, Perks, Mutators, and civilization-specific Talent Tracks, delivering meaningful variety and replayability. 

New Worlds to Conquer 

Two new biomes, inspired by the lands shaped by the Vikings and Scots, bring the atmosphere of the North to life.

When family is all you have left…how far will you go to protect it?

After society was ripped apart by undead hands, pockets of civilization emerge from the chaos. But at what cost? Can the living be trusted on this new frontier?
 
As Javier, a young man determined to find the family taken from him, you meet a young girl who has experienced her own unimaginable loss. Her name is Clementine, and your fates are bound together in a story where every choice you make could be your last.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Travel back in time in Jewels of the Wild West®! A struggling frontier town in a faraway and beautiful corner of the Old West needs your help to be brought back to its former glory. Play thousands of match-3 levels, meet charismatic characters, follow the suspenseful storyline and help transform this resilient town into the pride of the Wild West!

This game is a unique and epic combination of city building and match-3, tied together with a storyline full of twists and turns and the free spirits and hardscrabble realities of the Wild West. You’re a talented builder who’s responded to a Help Wanted ad in Colinstown, a troubled outpost in the Old West. Help the determined citizens revive their community after devastating attacks by the Butler Gang, who may be bankrolled by the corrupt tycoon Richard Pierce. Reconstruct an impressive town worthy of Wild West legends, become the new mayor of Colinstown and thwart the evil machinations of the outlaws to ensure that fortune favors your citizens once again!

● PLAY through a unique combination of match-3 and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure filled with the history and tales of the Wild West
● MEET townspeople, cowboys, miners, bankers, outlaws and bounty hunters on your way to prosperity
● MASTER thousands of unique match-3 levels
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos
● UNLOCK a variety of beautiful buildings and town landmarks to rebuild and upgrade
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.

You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Cuphead & The Delicious Last Course is a bundle containing the original Cuphead adventure, and the follow-up expansion The Delicious Last Course.

In Cuphead, players battle screen-filling bosses in a run and gun action experience inspired by cartoons of the 1930s. Play as Cuphead or Mugman (in single player or local co-op) as you traverse strange worlds, acquire new weapons, learn powerful super moves, and discover hidden secrets while you try to pay your debt back to the devil!

In The Delicious Last Course, Cuphead and Mugman are joined by Ms. Chalice for a DLC add-on adventure on a brand new island! With new weapons, new charms, and Ms. Chalice’s brand new abilities, take on a new cast of wacky, transforming bosses to assist the jolly Chef Saltbaker in Cuphead’s final challenging quest.

Both titles contain visuals and audio created with the authentic techniques of the era they were inspired by, including traditional hand drawn cel animation, watercolor backgrounds, and hours of original jazz recordings!

Note: The Delicious Last Course can be experienced shortly after beginning the original Cuphead game, and Ms. Chalice can be enjoyed as a playable character in all stages once unlocked!

Winner of more than 200 ‘Best Of’ awards, Fallout 4: Game of the Year Edition includes Bethesda Game Studio's critically acclaimed Fallout 4 plus all six official add-ons: Automatron, Wasteland Workshop, Far Harbor, Contraptions Workshop, Vault-Tec Workshop and Nuka-World!

As the sole survivor of Vault 111, only you can rebuild and determine the fate of Fallout 4's Wasteland. Join multiple factions vying for power or go it alone - the choices are yours.

From a Power Armor-toting soldier to charismatic smooth-talker, be whoever you want with the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. character system and develop your playstyle from hundreds of Perks.

Experience exciting first- or third-person combat with the dynamic Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System, or V.A.T.S., targeting enemies for maximum tactical advantage (and cinematic carnage!)

Collect, upgrade and build thousands of items with Fallout 4's crafting system, including weapons, armor, and even your own customizable settlements. 

Welcome home.

PreviewImage.Caption: The Secret Society® - Hidden Object Mystery Game

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Solve puzzles and riddles in a hidden object mobile adventure!

Seek and piece together notes to solve great enigmas. Immerse yourself in a mysterious story with unexpected plot twists while you explore worlds full of enchanting characters. Swap and match gems in an ingenious puzzle wrapped in a hidden objects mystery. Enjoy updates with additional quests to find clues and continue your own journey.

The Secret Society® is a clandestine community of people with the unique ability to move through magical worlds, find hidden treasures and play mystery puzzles. Your dear uncle has suddenly gone missing. After a period of despair, you realize that you too are blessed with these special powers and only you can find him! Go on a mystery adventure, browse hidden objects and complete quests to protect the sacred Artifact of the Order and thwart the forces threatening the entire society in this fantastic world of hidden object pictures and puzzles!

While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.

You can play this game even if you’re offline!

Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish.
